title: Election
definition: Election is God's gracious choice in Christ to save a people for Himself before the foundation of the world.
summary: Election teaches that salvation rests on God's gracious purpose in Christ, not on foreseen merit or human boasting.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the chosen and beloved Son in whom God's people are chosen, redeemed, and brought safely home.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Election teaches that God's saving purpose began before the believer's first step toward Him. Scripture speaks of God's gracious choosing in Christ so that salvation rests on mercy, not human boasting.

This doctrine should not be handled as a cold argument or a weapon in debate. In Scripture, election produces worship, humility, assurance, holiness, and confidence in God's faithful purpose.

Election is always connected to Christ. God chose His people in Him, saves them through Him, and intends that they be conformed to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Anxious believers often fear that salvation depends on the strength of their own grip. This doctrine teaches that grace began with God, is secured in Christ, and moves toward holiness rather than pride or laziness.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let election lead you to worship, not argument. Bow low before God's mercy, pursue holiness as one loved by grace, and share the Gospel freely because God saves through the message of Christ.
